notes.title: DOOM TOMB Patch: Alpha 7.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]Ability rebalance & Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Snare: If you've played DOOM TOMB, chances are you've had the lovely experience of being trapped in the elevator for 15 seconds by a Snare. Fear no more! A demon can now hit a snare 3 times to break it! (Also, fixed a bug where snares wouldn't de-spawn)

[*] Clone: Fixed the ability so that Demon clone moves at demon speed, and explorer clone moves at explorer speed.
[/list]

[h2]Networking improvements:[/h2]
[list]

[*] Reworked tethering network code so there's less movement jitter at higher latencies. Position correction now only happens at the end of the grapple, which should make it easier to perform short grapples effectively as a client.

[*] Extended duration of Demon Swipe hit box, to make the game less frustrating for higher ping players.

[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]

[*] Fixed "Perching" issue, where players could stand on minuscule unintended ledges

[*] Fixed bug where players would continue installing components for a short while after being hit

[*] Fixed bug where players could not extract components

[*] Fixed bug where Demon music wouldn't play for clients

[*]Fixed small ledge issues for Dig Site
[/list]

notes.title: DOOM TOMB Patch: Alpha 3.5.0
notes.content:
[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Explorer "Punch":[/b] It was frustrating to have extracting / installing actions constantly interrupted. It now costs 5 willpower to interrupt an action (it still only costs 1 willpower to punch a player who isn't installing / extracting)
[*] [b]Jump Pad Rune:[/b] It could be very frustrating to chase a player with a bunch of jump pad runes available. There is now a 1 second channel time to allow for some counterplay.
[*] [b]Dream Journal:[/b] Since the willpower transfer to teammate update, willpower items are too strong. Willpower given decreased from 8->5
[*] [b]Chad's Jacket: [/b]For the same reason as Dream Journal, Willpower given decreased from 10 -> 7
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]The explorer "punch":[/b] now comes out faster so it isn't as awkward to time the hit.
[*] [b]Extracting / installing:[/b] There's now an animation to show when a player is extracting / installing.
[*] [b]Component Visibility:[/b] New players had difficulty finding components around the map.  To help new players better track the objective, components now glow orange through walls, and this glow disappears when that component is already installed
[*] [b]Fire Pit Visibility: [/b]Players also had trouble finding fire pits, which is an essential part of finding other players. Fire pits now glow red through walls to show new players where to go
[*] [b]Invisibility: [/b]Players can now see their outlines in black as they go invisible, this will help Invis users avoid bumping into walls and obstacles when invisible. They can also jump and let go of sprint while invisible without cancelling their ability.
[*] [b]How to Play menu:[/b] Updated with additional slide explaining the explorer "punch" mechanic / an up to date component extraction video.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs fixes and adjustments: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where clients that cancelled a grapple early could get stuck in a state where they'd "teleport" around
[*] Numerous small adjustments to The Tomb and Dig Site (obstacles, clipping structures, etc..)
[*] Fix a bug where xray/soul seeing would show some blue on a pink character
[*] Fixed a bug where you could immediately hit a players after being hit to transfer the demon back
[*] Fixed a bug where being hit while installing or extracting would let you move around while "downed"
[/list]

notes.title: DOOM TOMB Update: Alpha 3.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]Survivor's "Push" ability:[/h2]

In 2 v 2s, players not being actively chased felt like they had little to do beside collect and install components. Players would basically ignore other non-possessed players and run to components and back to the elevator over and over. That was pretty boring, so...

Explorers can now left click to [i]hit other players[/i]. When another player is hit, they are [b]knocked back[/b] and their installing or extracting component action is cancelled. This ability costs 1 willpower per hit, so use it sparingly! (You can also push your teammates to launch them through the air) 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KQC3Yy9aqMJ8d2BbyQ/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: DOOM TOMB Update: Alpha 3.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Quality of life changes:[/h1]

[h3]Team recognition: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Players felt it was too difficult to distinguish teams from the color of the backpack. Explorers now carry a glowing outline of their team's color to limit confusion. 

[*] On a similar note, there was no way to distinguish between team mates and enemies when using the x-ray ability / seeing souls. Players now have their silhouettes matching their team's color.

[*] The player details bar now shows the name of each player, accurately tracks the number of components held, and has a clear indicator showing who is possessed.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Climb:[/b] The lack of cooldown made this ability far too easy to abuse. Climb now has an 8 second cooldown between uses.

[*] [b]Xay:[/b] No longer requires the user to be grounded.

[*] [b]The Ravine: [/b]The warp zone still let the explorers get too much distance on the demon. The demon now warps closer to the ground to reduce distance gained by explorers.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixes a bug where hitting a player while they were installing a component would let the installation go through
[/list]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

Join the community discord server to find out! Your feedback and suggestions are welcome!

notes.title: DOOM TOMB UPDATE: Alpha 3.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]New map: The Ravine.[/h1]

This map takes [b]DOOM TOMB[/b] to new [i]heights.[/i] On their way to the sacred tomb, the explorers scaled across a large ravine, building bridges, boost pads, and staircases along the way. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/44RAIz8GJLlF7eBqXn/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Climb Ability: [/b]This ability felt underwhelming and with very narrow uses. The ability was reworked to allow players to change direction mid climb, and improve ability consistency. The crouch speed was also problematic at some areas of certain maps. Crouch speed decreased from 450 -> 300 (still much greater than the default 150 crouch speed)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1Sw2Q4QRKase0ms2Hr/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Obstacle:[/b] Users could trap themselves in a corner and spam the obstacle ability to be permanently out of the demon's reach. The Obstacle will now disappear 3 seconds before the ability comes off cooldown (used to stay active for the entire ability cooldown). Additionally, Obstacle users can now see a shadow of where the obstacle would be placed so they don't stun themselves as often!

[*] [b]Xray: [/b]This ability has felt quite underwhelming. Active time increased from 3 -> 5 seconds

[*] [b]Dream Journal: [/b]The item has been simply too strong. Now can only be used when not possessed. Reading time increased from 3 -> 4 seconds. Willpower gain decreased from 10 -> 8.

[*] [b]Chad's Jacket:[/b] In the previous patch, teammates will drain each other's willpower instead of dying. This change made Chad's jacket much too strong. Willpower decreased from 20 -> 10 
[/list]

What's next?

Join the community discord server to find out! Your feedback and suggestions are welcome!
https://discord.com/invite/ecfA7XWW3E

notes.title: DOOM TOMB Patch: Alpha 2.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]Game mode changes:[/h2]

No one likes being stuck in spectator mode. Instead of dying, players will now siphon willpower from their healthy teammates and keep playing! Win as a team, or die as a team!

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Obstacle rune was simply too strong. To allow for some better counterplay, the user must channel for 1 second before use (channeling doesn’t decrease move speed in this case)
[*] The last changes to drift weren’t enough, the ability was still underwhelming. Steering has been drastically increased. Cooldown decreased from 18s -> 14s
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where obstacle would cause severe camera jitter for clients
[*] Fixed bug where Steam VR would boot on game startup
[*] Fixed bug where willpower would decrease when downed
[/list]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

notes.title: DOOM TOMB PATCH: ALPHA 1.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Do you like Jump Pads?[/b] Everyone likes [i]Jump Pads[/i]. Maybe you’ve dreamed of having a spare one to combo with your Glide ability. Maybe you just like the [i]Boing[/i] sound when you bounce on one. Either way, you can now select the jump pad as your Item to combo with your ability of choice. You can even use it alongside the Jump Pad ability for even more Jump Pads!

[*]On a similar note, Players can also choose a [i]deployable obstacle[/i] as a selectable Item to combo with other abilities, such as [i]Invisibility[/i] to make a clean getaway, or maybe just the [i]Obstacle[/i] ability to block off twice as many passageways. 

[*]Leveling system: Players will now start level 1 and unlock abilities and items as they complete matches.

[*]Some quality of life changes:
[list]
[*]Your selected loadout will now persist when returning to the lobby, no need to re-select your loadout before getting into another game.
[*]Players can now cancel the Drift and Glide abilities by pressing their ability button a second time!
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Join the community discord server linked on the store page to find out! Your feedback and suggestions are welcome!

notes.title: DOOM TOMB PATCH: ALPHA 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The in game UI has had some visual improvements which should help with clarity and visibility.
[*] Invisibility has felt quite weak with very narrow use cases. To help with this, Invisibility duration increased from 4 -> 5 seconds.
[*] The previous patch added more obstacles to the bottom side of the map, and successfully created better gameplay on that side. To continue with this theme, the top side of the map has had obstacles added as well.
[*] Networking adjustments which help reduce client side movement jitter.
[/list]

[b]What's next?[/b]

Join the community discord server linked on the store page to find out! Your feedback and suggestions are welcome!

notes.title: Path notes: DOOM TOMB Alpha version 0.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Certain sections of the map were devoid of obstacles, making it undesirable for explorers to lead the demon to these section. Obstacles have been added to these sections to encourage players to make better use of the entire map.
[*] The game now has a rating system to reflect a player's skill level. The amount of rating gain / lost depends on the difference in the combined rating for each team. Players will start at 1200 and work their way up (or down). 
[*] Bugfix: Client side moment was jittery after transferring the demon, this issue is now fixed.
[/list]

[b]What's next?[/b]

Join the community discord server linked on the store page to find out! Your feedback and suggestions are welcome!
